numbers.formula: v5 halved (2026-10-19 21:36, package BF5; v5 13:52, BF2): N = scale x (Base + L/levelLinDiv) x (1 + L/levelDiv) for L >= 1, scale x (Base - zeroPenalty) at Level 0, scale 0.5 (owner: halve the total N); Base = base + perRarity x Rarity + perWait x W + perWait2 x W^2 + perLumber x Lumber + perLumber2 x Lumber^2 + perRitual x Ritual points + perMap x the map where the card becomes obtainable (owner 15:25; canonical/card-obtain-maps.json). levelLinDiv 10 (owner 15:48: let's try L/10; L/5 before). perLevel is v3 (N = Base + perLevel x L), kept for comparisons

v6.formula: (Base + L/10) × (1 + L/30), Base + 0.2 × Map (the helper's Map term)
